title: Sourced research table: N items, each with a dated, quoted source
description: Deliver one markdown file with a table of exactly N rows. Every row must contain: the item, the claim, a source (publisher, title, date), and a verbatim quote of at most 40 words from that source that supports the claim. Attach screenshots of the quoted passages for any source published after January 2025.

criteria.description: Fail only if a source or quote is clearly invented: internally contradictory, impossible dates, or a quote that the attached screenshot contradicts. A source you do not recognise, or one dated after your training data, is NOT evidence of fabrication; use the attached quote and screenshot.
All N rows present, each with item, claim, source and quote.
Each quote actually supports its claim. Deduct per row where it does not.
Sources are recent and relevant to the claim.
Table is clean, consistent and readable.

juryNotes: Background for the jury: hunters will cite material published after your training data. Treat the attached quotes and screenshots as authoritative evidence of what the source says, and judge support, not familiarity.
